As a Senior Creative Engineer , you are a seasoned professional in digital design and creative production at scale. You will work with an amazing team of creatives to ensure artwork is designed and adapted according to our client’s brand guidelines while maintaining the highest quality standards. You will take design briefs and key art from the account and creative team, ensuring conceptual creative ideas are translated into scalable digital assets ready for market.
You are an ideal candidate if you come from an advertising agency or production design studio and have worked across a variety of creative projects including digital campaigns, marketing collateral, motion graphics, brand work, advertising, and high-volume production.

You enjoy building scalable design systems, creating templates, mentoring others, and continuously improving creative workflows. You are adaptable, eager to learn new technologies and automation tools, and thrive in fast-paced environments.

Collaborate with the Creative Team to bring their ideas to life while ensuring best practices and brand standards remain top of mind.
Design and adapt key art into pixel-perfect digital assets across multiple formats, sizes, and platforms.
Create and maintain scalable templates and design systems to support high-volume creative production.
Produce high-quality motion graphics and animated assets for digital campaigns.
Bring forward ideas to improve the team’s systems, templates, automation, and creative production workflows.
Work with internal teams, Account, and Creative to ensure continuity of delivery of final files within agreed timeframes and to high standards.
Become fully ingrained in the brand’s design systems and act as a gatekeeper of brand guidelines.
Mentor junior and mid-level Creative Engineers, supporting their technical and production design development while fostering collaboration and team growth.
Understand technical limitations across digital platforms and recommend creative solutions that maximize design quality and platform performance.
Build clean, organized creative files that support scalable production and future campaign adaptations.
Create detailed documentation and template guides to clearly communicate production workflows and design systems.
Stay up to date on digital production best practices, motion design trends, creative technologies, and automation tools.
Demonstrate adaptability and a continuous learning mindset while embracing new tools and evolving production processes.

3–5 years of experience working as a Production Designer, Designer, Motion Designer, or Creative Engineer in an advertising agency, production studio, or design environment.
Extensive experience working within high-volume, high-scale creative production workflows.
Strong experience building and maintaining design systems, templates, and scalable creative assets.
Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including After Effects for motion design.
Strong motion design and animation skills.
Advanced proficiency in Figma (Sketch experience is a plus).
Experience with, or willingness to learn, creative automation platforms such as Celtra or Orca Plus .
Experience building and editing Keynote and PowerPoint presentations.
A collaborative mindset with the ability to mentor and develop junior team members.
Pixel-perfect attention to detail with a strong commitment to quality assurance.
Expertise in layout production, image optimization, static and animated digital advertising, email production, and visual guidelines.
General understanding of HTML5.
Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and the ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies.

About the job The Creative Technologist will support the Android Brand and Google Play Creative team by building the tools, workflows, demos, and prototypes that help creative ideas get stronger and move faster. This role has two connected parts.

First, you will help improve the team’s creative process by building internal tools and AI-enabled workflows for briefing, ideation, prototyping, review, production, localization, and scale. Second, you will help turn Google product capabilities into campaign ideas, product demos, prototypes, and consumer-facing stories.

You will work closely with creative leads, brand marketers, designers, writers, PMMs, producers, product managers, engineers, and external partners to make ideas tangible. The strongest candidate will bring technical fluency, creative judgment, product accuracy, and a builder’s mindset.

What we are looking for We are seeing a Creative Technologist who is excited by emerging technology and can help the Android Brand and Google Play Creative team move faster, think sharper, and make more original work by turning emerging technology into useful tools, demos, prototypes, and creative workflows.

This role sits between creative, product, and technology. You will help articulate campaign ideas, translate product capabilities into clear consumer stories, and make those ideas tangible. The right candidate is part creative thinker, part technical maker, part systems builder, and part AI craftsperson.

You should be able to move quickly across AI tools, Figma, lightweight code, APIs, no-code/low-code platforms, and production tools to help teams see what is possible and make stronger creative decisions. Originally posted on Himalayas

About WPP Production
We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.
About WPP
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .
A Hybrid working model
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
What does a Senior Creative Technologist do at WPP Production?

A Senior Creative Technologist is a confident technical and creative leader who delivers exceptional work and elevates the team around them with +10 years of experience. The candidate should have strong understanding of the creative and production industry, ultimately worked within a creative agency (or in-house agency) or a production company for a vast majority of their career.
They can shape ideas, briefs and expand on concepts, not only execute them.
They don’t just build prototypes; they think about how things can scale.
They don’t just solve problems; they spot them early and think about mitigating risk.
They are comfortable working with clients and have strong presentation skills.
The Senior CT plays a supporting leadership role across strategic and creative delivery, mentoring and standards. Senior CTs own workstreams, line manage junior team members and help ensure that what we ship is technically robust, creatively ambitious and compliant with corporate and client expectations.

The Senior CT has strong technical capabilities to guide teams about the suitable models they should work with for each project and provide technical support for the different models, programs and tools.

· Line manages Creative Technologists

· Set clear expectations and support personal development plans

· Run regular, 1:1 with honest feedback loops

· Actively mentor less confident team members, creating space for them to grow

· Confidently propose and justify technical approaches in response to briefs

· Take responsibility for ensuring creative and technical output meets corporate and client standards

· Work closely with Producers/PMs to scope realistically and protect quality

· Turn ideas into meaningful prototypes that support internal new business

· Balance experimentation with integrated production discipline

· Anticipate technical risks and resolve issues early

· Develop scalable workflows across AI, real-time and other emerging tech

· Encourage ownership and pride in output

· Share knowledge openly and raise the overall capability of the team

· Escalate when something doesn’t match the brief or standards

· Be the bridge between Creative, Strategy, Production and Tech

· Clearly explain complex technical approaches to non-technical audiences

· Represent the Creative Technology team confidently in client settings

· Provide transparent updates on progress, blockers and risks

· Give constructive, solution-focused feedback

· Proactively identify opportunities to prototype new ideas or tools

· Contribute to group R&D initiatives

· Stay curious about emerging tech and share insights with the team

· Strong capability across multiple areas such as: Unreal (Blueprints, UEFN, Verse), creative coding, generative AI workflows, AR/VR, 3D, interaction design, world building, automation pipelines etc.

· Proven ability to deliver high-quality technical work with minimal oversight

· Experience mentoring or line managing junior team members

· Strong troubleshooting skills across technical/creative pipelines

· Confident communicator both internally and with clients.

· Comfortable working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments

· High standards and a strong sense of accountability

· Great collaborator and team player that is used to working with multiple stakeholders co-owning a project

· Commercial awareness and understanding of production realities

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry.

You’ll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity.

With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP’s unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Monks is seeking a Creative Technologist in Buenos Aires to serve as the vital connective tissue between high-concept creative design , emerging technical execution, and top-tier global client delivery. We are looking for someone who bridges an undeniable design eye with deep technical acumen , optimizing for a candidate with a high-quality track record of applying novel and emerging technologies to scale top-tier creative output across multimodal mediums rather than sheer length of tenure.
In this role, you will embody the philosophy of selecting the right technical approach for the right job—pragmatically evaluating, benchmarking, and pairing the ideal tools, generative AI models, node-based computational workflows, and tech stacks tailored specifically to the brief at hand.
Operating in a highly dynamic environment, you will collaborate across diverse multidisciplinary partners—including Account Management, Program & Project Management, Creative Directors, and Technical Leads—as well as interfacing directly with client teams.
Above all, this position requires a proactive, project-enhancing mindset. We need a self-starter who actively seeks out ways to elevate creative delivery, anticipates roadblocks, and shapes project outcomes rather than waiting for the next ticket to show up in a queue.

Technical Evaluation & Benchmarking ("Right AI Approach for the Creative System"): Systematically evaluate and benchmark the output quality of various tools, frameworks, and generative AI models against one another to select the most suitable approach for high-fidelity creative delivery.
Proactive Delivery Enhancement: Drive projects forward with an ownership mindset—actively identifying opportunities to elevate quality, optimize pipelines, and streamline execution without waiting for top-down task assignments.
Multimodal GenAI & Node Workflows: Harness, benchmark, and orchestrate generative AI models across modalities (image, music, voiceover, video manipulation) and construct node-based computational workflows to scale creative execution.
Brand Nuance & Contextual Adaptation: Understand and execute the subtle nuances of various brand marks and identity systems across physical, digital, and game-style worlds.
Upfront Feasibility Evaluation: Interrogate briefs early alongside Creative Directors and strategy leads to assess technical viability, flag platform limitations, define optimal tech stacks, and protect creative ambition before production begins.
Cross-Functional & Client Engagement: Partner dynamically across internal disciplines (Account Managers, Program/Project Managers, Creative Directors, and Technical Leads) and engage directly with client teams to present prototypes and manage delivery milestones.
Proactive Global Communication: Maintain continuous alignment across global teams and client partners with exceptional English communication—setting expectations early, raising flags proactively, and translating complex technical trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders.

Design Eye Meets Technical Acumen: High visual design sensitivity (typography, UI/UX polish, spatial aesthetics) combined with clean coding abilities.
AI-Native Development Fluency: Comfort working within modern AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Anti-Gravity, Cursor, Claude Code) to rapidly build, iterate, and ship solutions.

Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern web standards (CSS, Tailwind) is expected, along with the ability to read, diagnose, and debug code but deep traditional full-stack depth is not a hard requirement. We're optimizing for speed and craft in AI-assisted iteration over classical engineering tenure.
System & Model Benchmarking Track Record: Proven experience evaluating, testing, and benchmarking emerging technical systems and generative AI models to determine output quality and suitability for tier-1 brand execution.
Proactive, Anti-Ticket Mindset: A self-directed operator who thrives in dynamic environments, takes initiative to solve unstated problems, and focuses on enhancing overall project delivery rather than passively checking off tickets.
Multimodal Generative AI Stack: Familiarity with generative AI models across image, music, voiceover/audio synthesis, and video manipulation/editing.
Modern Design & Creative Tools: Proficiency with modern design platforms (Framer, Figma) and the Adobe Creative Cloud suite, along with familiarity with node-based creative logic systems (e.g., ComfyUI, Weavy).
Brand System Literacy: Proven ability to navigate, interpret, and maintain brand identity integrity across diverse visual environments (digital, physical, and gaming/3D contexts).
Global English Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with the confidence to lead technical conversations with client teams and collaborate across global time zones.

Nodal / VFX Background: Experience with Nuke, Fusion, Houdini, or ComfyUI is a huge plus. This background signals a proven ability to architect the technical processes needed to reach beautifully crafted, production-grade output.
Google Platform & Web Ecosystem: Familiarity with Google web standards, Google Cloud tools, or Google creative and media platforms.
Scalable Multimodal & 3D Delivery: Hands-on technical execution to scale creative assets across web, 3D interactive environments, and spatial mediums, maintaining strict visual and performance standards.
3D Web Frameworks: Experience with Three.js, WebGL, or Babylon.js.

Portfolio submission required with application. Please include examples that speak to craft quality and technical problem-solving, not just final polish.
